title: CrowdStrike acquires Israel-based browser security startup Seraphic, a source says for around $400M; Seraphic has raised around $37M in total (Meir Orbach/CTech)
summary: Meir Orbach / CTech: CrowdStrike acquires Israel-based browser security startup Seraphic, a source says for around $400M; Seraphic has raised around $37M in total — Founded in 2020, the Israeli company focuses on embedding security directly into the browser. — CrowdStrike is acquiring Israeli startup Seraphic Security.
contentText:
Meir Orbach / CTech :

CrowdStrike acquires Israel-based browser security startup Seraphic, a source says for ~$400M; Seraphic was founded in 2020, employs 50+, and had raised ~$37M   —  Founded in 2020, the Israeli company focuses on embedding security directly into the browser.  —  CrowdStrike is acquiring Israeli startup Seraphic Security.
